## Which file?

| Purpose | Download or install |
| --- | --- |
| Server on Apple silicon macOS | `grasshopper-server-darwin-arm64-VERSION.zip` |
| Server on Linux x86-64 | `grasshopper-server-linux-amd64-VERSION.zip` |
| Server on Windows x86-64 | `grasshopper-server-windows-amd64-VERSION.zip` |
| Client CLI or Claude archive on Apple silicon macOS | `grasshopper-client-darwin-arm64-VERSION.zip` |
| Client CLI or Claude archive on Linux x86-64 | `grasshopper-client-linux-amd64-VERSION.zip` |
| Client CLI or Claude archive on Windows x86-64 | `grasshopper-client-windows-amd64-VERSION.zip` |
| Agent plugins | Follow [setup](https://usegrasshopper.com/setup/); no archive needed |
| Marketplace maintenance | `grasshopper-marketplace-VERSION.zip` |

Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS`. Executables are unsigned; see
[unsigned archives](https://github.com/MylesMCook/grasshopper/blob/main/docs/operations.md#unsigned-archives).
Before updating a server, follow [back up and update](https://github.com/MylesMCook/grasshopper#back-up-and-update-the-server)
and keep the previous archive for rollback.
